Name: Liquid Glass
Description: Прозора скляна капсула: розмиті шпалери за нею заломлюються на краях, відкрита категорія — лінза, рух пружний.
StyleResources:
<ResourceDictionary xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" xmlns:fx="clr-namespace:CategoryBar.Theming;assembly=CategoryBar">
  <!--
    Liquid Glass. A surface is one flat sheet of clear, lightly tinted glass: no gloss bands, no bevel gradients.
    What makes it glass is optics. The "liquid" shader takes the blurred desktop wallpaper behind the
    surface, bends it inside the rim like a lens (with a trace of colour fringing) and lights the rim; a hairline
    then catches the light. The open tab and the hovered row are a second, thinner sheet lying on the first.
  -->
  <LinearGradientBrush x:Key="Glass.Hairline" StartPoint="0.1,0" EndPoint="0.9,1">
    <GradientStop Color="#B0FFFFFF" Offset="0"/><GradientStop Color="#14FFFFFF" Offset="0.4"/><GradientStop Color="#0AFFFFFF" Offset="0.65"/><GradientStop Color="#58FFFFFF" Offset="1"/>
  </LinearGradientBrush>

  <ControlTemplate x:Key="Theme.MaterialTemplate" TargetType="ContentControl">
    <Grid>
      <Border Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" CornerRadius="{Binding Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent}}">
        <Border.Effect>
          <fx:ThemeShaderEffect Shader="liquid" Auxiliary="{DynamicResource Theme.Backdrop}" P5="{DynamicResource Theme.Backdrop.Enabled}"
                                P0="{DynamicResource Theme.Parameter.specular}" P1="{DynamicResource Theme.Parameter.refraction}" P4="{DynamicResource Theme.Parameter.bevel}" P6="{DynamicResource Theme.Parameter.dispersion}"
                                P7="{Binding Tag.TopLeft, RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent}}"
                                P2="{Binding ActualWidth, RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent}}" P3="{Binding ActualHeight, RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent}}"/>
        </Border.Effect>
      </Border>
      <Border BorderThickness="1" Opacity="{DynamicResource Theme.Parameter.rim}" CornerRadius="{Binding Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent}}">
        <Border.BorderBrush>
          <LinearGradientBrush StartPoint="0.1,0" EndPoint="0.9,1">
            <GradientStop Color="{DynamicResource Theme.Parameter.rim-color.Color}" Offset="0"/><GradientStop Color="#14FFFFFF" Offset="0.4"/><GradientStop Color="#0AFFFFFF" Offset="0.65"/><GradientStop Color="#58FFFFFF" Offset="1"/>
          </LinearGradientBrush>
        </Border.BorderBrush>
      </Border>
    </Grid>
  </ControlTemplate>
  <!-- Controls are a thin flat sheet: their tint only. -->
  <ControlTemplate x:Key="Theme.ControlMaterialTemplate" TargetType="ContentControl">
    <Border Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}" CornerRadius="{Binding Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent}}"/>
  </ControlTemplate>

  <!-- The window, its page and title bar are the room the panes float in; they carry no rim of their own. -->
  <ControlTemplate x:Key="Theme.WindowTemplate" TargetType="fx:ThemeSurface">
    <Grid Background="Transparent">
      <Border Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" IsHitTestVisible="False"/>
      <Grid><Grid.RowDefinitions><RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><RowDefinition/></Grid.RowDefinitions>
        <ContentControl Style="{DynamicResource Theme.TitleBar}" Height="{DynamicResource titlebar.Height}" Content="{TemplateBinding Header}"/>
        <ContentPresenter Grid.Row="1"/>
      </Grid>
    </Grid>
  </ControlTemplate>
  <ControlTemplate x:Key="Theme.TitleBarTemplate" TargetType="ContentControl"><Grid Background="Transparent"><ContentPresenter/></Grid></ControlTemplate>
  <ControlTemplate x:Key="Theme.PageTemplate" TargetType="ContentControl"><Grid Background="Transparent"><ContentPresenter Margin="{TemplateBinding Padding}"/></Grid></ControlTemplate>

  <!-- Tabs have no fill of their own. Opening a category lays a second sheet of glass under its name. -->
  <ControlTemplate x:Key="Theme.TabTemplate" TargetType="ContentControl">
    <Grid Background="Transparent">
      <Border x:Name="hover" CornerRadius="{DynamicResource tab.Radius}" Background="{DynamicResource tab:hover.Background}" Opacity="0" IsHitTestVisible="False"/>
      <Grid x:Name="lens" Opacity="0" IsHitTestVisible="False" fx:ThemeTransform.Scale="1">
        <Border CornerRadius="{DynamicResource tab.Radius}" Background="{DynamicResource tab:selected.Background}">
          <Border.Effect><DropShadowEffect BlurRadius="10" ShadowDepth="2" Direction="270" Opacity="0.22"/></Border.Effect>
        </Border>
        <Border CornerRadius="{DynamicResource tab.Radius}" BorderThickness="1" BorderBrush="{StaticResource Glass.Hairline}" Opacity="{DynamicResource Theme.Parameter.rim}"/>
      </Grid>
      <ContentPresenter Margin="{TemplateBinding Padding}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
      <Ellipse x:Name="running" Width="4" Height="4" Margin="0,0,0,4" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Fill="{DynamicResource Accent}" Opacity="0" IsHitTestVisible="False"/>
    </Grid>
    <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
      <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
        <Setter TargetName="hover" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/>
        <Trigger.EnterActions><BeginStoryboard><Storyboard FillBehavior="Stop"><DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="hover" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.14"/></Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.EnterActions>
        <Trigger.ExitActions><BeginStoryboard><Storyboard FillBehavior="Stop"><DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="hover" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="1" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.2"/></Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.ExitActions>
      </Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="fx:ThemeVisual.IsRunning" Value="True"><Setter TargetName="running" Property="Opacity" Value="0.9"/></Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="fx:ThemeVisual.IsSelected" Value="True">
        <Setter TargetName="lens" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/><Setter TargetName="hover" Property="Visibility" Value="Hidden"/>
        <Trigger.EnterActions><BeginStoryboard><Storyboard FillBehavior="Stop">
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="lens" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.14"/>
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="lens" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Scale)" From="0.76" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.42"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><ElasticEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Oscillations="1" Springiness="5"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
        </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.EnterActions>
        <Trigger.ExitActions><BeginStoryboard><Storyboard FillBehavior="Stop">
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="lens" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="1" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.18"/>
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="lens" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Scale)" From="1" To="0.88" Duration="0:0:0.18"/>
        </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.ExitActions>
      </Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="fx:ThemeVisual.IsDropTarget" Value="True"><Setter TargetName="lens" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/></Trigger>
    </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
  </ControlTemplate>

  <ControlTemplate x:Key="Theme.MenuItemTemplate" TargetType="ContentControl">
    <Grid Background="Transparent">
      <Grid x:Name="lens" Opacity="0" IsHitTestVisible="False" fx:ThemeTransform.ScaleX="1">
        <Border CornerRadius="{DynamicResource menu-item.Radius}" Background="{DynamicResource menu-item:hover.Background}"/>
        <Border CornerRadius="{DynamicResource menu-item.Radius}" BorderThickness="1" BorderBrush="{StaticResource Glass.Hairline}" Opacity="0.5"/>
      </Grid>
      <Border x:Name="drop" CornerRadius="{DynamicResource menu-item.Radius}" BorderThickness="2" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource Accent}" Opacity="0" IsHitTestVisible="False"/>
      <ContentPresenter Margin="{TemplateBinding Padding}" VerticalAlignment="{TemplateBinding VerticalContentAlignment}"/>
    </Grid>
    <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
      <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
        <Setter TargetName="lens" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/>
        <Trigger.EnterActions><BeginStoryboard><Storyboard FillBehavior="Stop">
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="lens" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.1"/>
          <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="lens" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.ScaleX)" From="0.95" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.22"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.6"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
        </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.EnterActions>
        <Trigger.ExitActions><BeginStoryboard><Storyboard FillBehavior="Stop"><DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="lens" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="1" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.16"/></Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.ExitActions>
      </Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="fx:ThemeVisual.IsSelected" Value="True"><Setter TargetName="lens" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/></Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="fx:ThemeVisual.IsDropTarget" Value="True"><Setter TargetName="lens" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/><Setter TargetName="drop" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/></Trigger>
    </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
  </ControlTemplate>

  <!-- Navigation: the current page is a thin sheet with a hairline, the rest stay bare until hovered. -->
  <ControlTemplate x:Key="Navigation.Template" TargetType="Button">
    <Grid Background="Transparent">
      <Border x:Name="hover" CornerRadius="{DynamicResource sidebar-item.Radius}" Background="{DynamicResource sidebar-item:hover.Background}" Opacity="0" IsHitTestVisible="False"/>
      <Grid x:Name="lens" Opacity="0" IsHitTestVisible="False">
        <Border CornerRadius="{DynamicResource sidebar-item.Radius}" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"/>
        <Border CornerRadius="{DynamicResource sidebar-item.Radius}" BorderThickness="1" BorderBrush="{StaticResource Glass.Hairline}" Opacity="0.5"/>
      </Grid>
      <ContentPresenter Margin="{TemplateBinding Padding}" HorizontalAlignment="{TemplateBinding HorizontalContentAlignment}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
    </Grid>
    <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
      <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True"><Setter TargetName="hover" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/></Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="Tag" Value="selected"><Setter TargetName="lens" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/><Setter TargetName="hover" Property="Visibility" Value="Hidden"/></Trigger>
    </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
  </ControlTemplate>

  <!-- A capsule switch with a flat white bead. -->
  <Style x:Key="Toggle" TargetType="CheckBox">
    <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand"/>
    <Setter Property="Template">
      <Setter.Value>
        <ControlTemplate TargetType="CheckBox">
          <Grid Width="46" Height="26" Background="Transparent">
            <Border x:Name="track" CornerRadius="13" Background="{DynamicResource Pressed}"/>
            <Border x:Name="lit" CornerRadius="13" Background="{DynamicResource Accent}" Opacity="0"/>
            <Border CornerRadius="13" BorderThickness="1" BorderBrush="{StaticResource Glass.Hairline}" Opacity="0.5"/>
            <Ellipse x:Name="knob" Width="20" Height="20" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Margin="3,0,0,0" Fill="White" fx:ThemeTransform.X="0">
              <Ellipse.Effect><DropShadowEffect BlurRadius="6" ShadowDepth="1" Direction="270" Opacity="0.3"/></Ellipse.Effect>
            </Ellipse>
          </Grid>
          <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
            <Trigger Property="IsChecked" Value="True">
              <Setter TargetName="lit" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/>
              <Setter TargetName="knob" Property="fx:ThemeTransform.X" Value="20"/>
              <Trigger.EnterActions><BeginStoryboard><Storyboard FillBehavior="Stop">
                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="knob" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.X)" From="0" To="20" Duration="0:0:0.3"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.7"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="lit" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.18"/>
              </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.EnterActions>
              <Trigger.ExitActions><BeginStoryboard><Storyboard FillBehavior="Stop">
                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="knob" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.X)" From="20" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.3"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.7"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="lit" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="1" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.18"/>
              </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.ExitActions>
            </Trigger>
            <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False"><Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.45"/></Trigger>
          </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
        </ControlTemplate>
      </Setter.Value>
    </Setter>
  </Style>
  <Style x:Key="Segment" TargetType="RadioButton">
    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource Text.Muted}"/><Setter Property="FontSize" Value="12.5"/>
    <Setter Property="Template">
      <Setter.Value>
        <ControlTemplate TargetType="RadioButton">
          <Grid MinHeight="30" Background="Transparent">
            <Grid x:Name="lens" Opacity="0">
              <Border CornerRadius="15" Background="{DynamicResource Pressed}"/>
              <Border CornerRadius="15" BorderThickness="1" BorderBrush="{StaticResource Glass.Hairline}" Opacity="0.5"/>
            </Grid>
            <ContentPresenter Margin="14,4" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
          </Grid>
          <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True"><Setter TargetName="lens" Property="Opacity" Value="0.5"/></Trigger>
            <Trigger Property="IsChecked" Value="True"><Setter TargetName="lens" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/><Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource Text}"/></Trigger>
          </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
        </ControlTemplate>
      </Setter.Value>
    </Setter>
  </Style>

  <!-- Motion: surfaces swell out of the bar and settle like a drop. "calm" keeps only short fades. -->
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Bar.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.2"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Y)" From="18" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.5"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><ElasticEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Oscillations="1" Springiness="6"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.ScaleX)" From="0.86" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.5"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><ElasticEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Oscillations="1" Springiness="6"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Tab.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.16"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Scale)" From="0.6" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.4"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.8"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Menu.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.14"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Scale)" From="0.82" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.42"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><ElasticEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Oscillations="1" Springiness="7"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Y)" From="12" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.3"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Menu.Exit" FillBehavior="HoldEnd">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.12"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Scale)" To="0.92" Duration="0:0:0.12"/>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Menu.Switch" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0.3" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.16"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Y)" From="6" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.22"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.MenuItem.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.18"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Y)" From="10" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.3"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.5"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Window.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.22"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Scale)" From="0.97" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.3"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Page.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.22"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Y)" From="12" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.3"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Toast.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.18"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Scale)" From="0.85" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.4"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><ElasticEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Oscillations="1" Springiness="7"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Toast.Exit" FillBehavior="HoldEnd">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.16"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Scale)" To="0.9" Duration="0:0:0.16"/>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Bar.Enter.calm" FillBehavior="Stop"><DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.2"/></Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Tab.Enter.calm" FillBehavior="Stop"><DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.2"/></Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Menu.Enter.calm" FillBehavior="Stop">
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.16"/>
    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(fx:ThemeTransform.Y)" From="6" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.2"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
  </Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.MenuItem.Enter.calm" FillBehavior="Stop"><DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.16"/></Storyboard>
  <Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Toast.Enter.calm" FillBehavior="Stop"><DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.2"/></Storyboard>
</ResourceDictionary>

Parameters.Label: Фон під склом
Parameters.Description: Крізь панель, меню й сповіщення видно розмиті шпалери робочого столу.

Parameters.Label: Розмиття фону
Parameters.Description: Менше — чіткіше зображення, більше — матове скло.

Parameters.Label: Заломлення на краях
Parameters.Description: Наскільки край скла, як лінза, згинає зображення за ним.

Parameters.Label: Ширина скляного краю
Parameters.Description: Смуга вздовж краю, де скло працює як лінза.

Parameters.Label: Густина скла
Parameters.Description: Скільки власного кольору скла лежить поверх фону.
